From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: On-prem air-gapped deployment: hardware & offline ops follow-up

Hi Tom / Sofia,

Thanks again for the call earlier  good to meet the team and walk through LegacyBank's constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard (confirmed):
- Preferred deployment: Private on-prem, fully air-gapped (no egress).
- Security: Customer-managed KMS/HSM on-site, audit logs retained for 7 years.
- Performance targets: 200 concurrent chat sessions (avg. 512 token context), peak sustained throughput ~60 requests/min.
- Ops: Need maintenance windows for nightly backups and an offline upgrade process.
- Physical: 2U x 4U racks expected, redundant power, 40Gbps internal network fabric preferred.

Open items / next steps:
1) We will send a hardware spec and an ops checklist for offline upgrades (attached).
2) Can you share a rack diagram and PDU/capacity info so we can validate power/space?
3) Schedule a follow-up technical call with your infra team (we suggest 30-45m).
4) We'll have/CC our solutions engineer (Vivek) and security lead (Priyom) on the next call to cover GPU/compute sizing and KMS integration.

Attachments: redwood_onprem_hw_specs_v2.pdf (high-level SKU recommendations).

If the summary above looks right, I'll go ahead and schedule the infra-focused call next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Hi team - quick technical clarifications ahead of the 6/28 call so we can be efficient: 

1) Power / PDUs: can you confirm the per-rack PDU capacity (amps @ voltage) and if there is a redundant A/B PDU? Also, do you have APC or Eaton PDUs?
2) GPU preference: do you have a preferred GPU vendor/series on-site (NVIDIA A40/A100/H100) or are you open to procurement recommendations?
3) Management network: even in an air-gapped environment, is there an isolated mgmt VLAN and an out-of-band console (iLO/iDRAC) policy we should know about?
4) Storage: any local NVMe pools available per node, or do you plan to rely on network storage (NAS)?
5) Upgrade process: confirm the offline upgrade window (hours/days) and whether snapshots/backups are taken locally before maintenance.

If you can attach the rack PDU spec and a short note on upgrade windows, I can map our BOM to your power/cooling constraints and flag any recommended changes.

Thanks,

Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
